title: Let layout and content communicate
rule: Let photos, content, layout, and working interactions carry their meaning. Do not add titles, labels, or marketing copy merely to fill space or explain what they already communicate. Remove decorative headings and redundant UI narration.
example: Mountain print — 12 × 18 in matte poster. / Choose a size before adding to cart. / Add to cart
counterexample: Explore Our Stunning Collection / Artwork Preview / Mountain print — 12 × 18 in matte poster. / Choose a size before adding to cart. / Add to cart
rationale: Redundant labels compete with the useful content and controls.
evidence: Migrated from existing SKILL.md guidance. Examples are illustrative; see deslopify/examples/website-copy.md.
